channel.title: ARLing Notes
channel.description: Krátke a presné odpovede na chyby, ktoré vývojári a slovenskí účtovníci stále hľadajú. Každá poznámka končí nástrojom, ktorý to skontroluje.

item.title: BR-CO-15 error: fix the invoice total with VAT
item.description: BR-CO-15 means the total with VAT is not the net total plus VAT in the invoice currency. Four causes we reproduced, the exact messages and the fix.

item.title: Cookies lišta na e-shope: povinnosti v roku 2026
item.description: Cookies lišta e-shopu v roku 2026: čo smie bežať bez súhlasu, čo žiada regulačný úrad, pokuta do 5 % obratu a ako lištu opraviť a overiť.

item.title: Funkcia na odstúpenie od zmluvy v e-shope: čo má byť na webe
item.description: Čo žiada § 20a od 19. 6. 2026: odkaz „odstúpiť od zmluvy tu“, tri údaje, samostatné tlačidlo a potvrdenie. Ako to overiť bezplatnou kontrolou e-shopu.

item.title: Peppol Invoice Validator: What It Checks and What It Misses
item.description: What a Peppol invoice validator checks, how fatal and warning differ, and what we saw when we broke one sample invoice eleven ways.

item.title: Puzzles for reMarkable and Kindle Scribe: what to check
item.description: Puzzles for reMarkable and Kindle Scribe are PDFs. Where to find them, which kinds suit a pen, what to test in a free sample and what we measured.

item.title: XRechnung kostenlos erstellen: Wege, Pflichtfelder, Grenzen
item.description: XRechnung kostenlos erstellen: OZG-RE-Weberfassung Schritt für Schritt, Gratis-Generatoren und die Felder, an denen unsere Testrechnungen scheiterten.

item.title: XRechnung prüfen: Ablauf, Werkzeuge und typische Fehler
item.description: XRechnung prüfen mit dem kostenlosen KoSIT-Validator: Befehl, Prüfbericht, zehn Testdateien mit echten Meldungen und was trotz Prüfung durchgeht.

item.title: Ako overiť odkazy v PDF na e-ink tablete
item.description: Ako vyskúšať obsah, prechod na inú stranu a návrat v PDF na počítači aj e-ink tablete. Čo dokazuje kontrola súboru a čo si overíte na vlastnej ukážke.

item.title: Formulárové polia v PDF: kam môžete písať klávesnicou
item.description: Ako rozlíšiť formulárové pole od poznámky v PDF, písať klávesnicou a overiť uloženie. Príklady z denníka Morning Quiet a hlavolamov Puzzle Post.

item.title: PDF-Formularfelder: Wo Sie mit der Tastatur schreiben
item.description: PDF-Formularfelder und Notizen unterscheiden, mit der Tastatur schreiben und das Speichern prüfen. Beispiele aus Morning Quiet und Puzzle Post.

item.title: PDF-Links auf dem E-Ink-Tablet prüfen
item.description: Inhaltsverzeichnis, Seitenwechsel und Rückweg im PDF am Computer und E-Ink-Tablet prüfen. Was Dateitests belegen und was Sie selbst ausprobieren.

item.title: The daily examen: five points, and what an evening page can hold
item.description: The five points of the examen as Saint Ignatius set them down, what each one asks at the end of a day, why an evening page can carry three questions instead of five headings, and what such a page must not claim.

item.title: How a logic puzzle is proved to have exactly one solution
item.description: What exactly one solution means, how a second independent search proves it, why a puzzle also has to be solvable without guessing, where the proof is written down in our files, and what the claim does not cover.

item.title: Lectio divina: the four steps, and what a journal is actually for
item.description: Lectio, meditatio, oratio, contemplatio: where the four steps come from, what each one asks of you, why a journal gives two of them lines and leaves two of them blank, and what a journal has no business claiming to be.

item.title: PDF form fields: typing, pen notes and what to test
item.description: How PDF form fields differ from annotations, which puzzle cells accept typing, and how to test a saved answer using a free Morning Quiet sample.

item.title: Testing PDF links on your e-ink tablet
item.description: Test PDF contents, destinations and return links before and after transfer to an e-ink tablet. What our file checks prove, and what needs your reader.

item.title: Psalm numbers, and how a 31 day reading plan decides where to stop
item.description: Why Psalm 23 is also Psalm 22, where the Hebrew and the Vulgate numbering part company and where they meet again, how a reading plan decides where to end a day, and what 31 days of Psalms and Gospel actually come to.

item.title: Putting a printable puzzle in a parish bulletin or a school newsletter
item.description: An editor's guide to dropping a logic puzzle into a parish sheet or a school newsletter: the one width that decides everything, why line work beats grey on a photocopier, printing at 100 percent, and the four things a licence has to say before you print.

item.title: Reading a novel of 953 pages on an e-ink tablet: what actually matters
item.description: What actually matters when a novel of 953 pages goes onto an e-ink tablet: line length and type size, a contents you can reach from any page, a band for the pen, and the honest note that the same texts are free as EPUB.

item.title: What the Douay-Rheims Bible is, and why we set that text
item.description: The Douay-Rheims Bible in plain terms: a Catholic translation from the Latin Vulgate in the Challoner revision of 1749 to 1752, what its public domain status rests on, the twelve transcription errors we corrected and the seventy six differences we left alone.

item.title: Why an A4 PDF does not fill an e-ink screen, with the arithmetic
item.description: The arithmetic behind a page made for an e-ink tablet: 1404 by 1872 dots at 226 dots per inch is 157.8 by 210.4 millimetres, an A4 page shown whole on that screen shrinks to 71 percent, and what else changes when a page is set for glass instead of paper.

item.title: Bank lehnt SEPA-Datei ab: die fünf häufigsten pain.001-Fehler
item.description: Wenn eine Bank eine SEPA-Sammelüberweisung ablehnt, liegt es an einem fehlerhaften Feld in der pain.001-Datei, die das Buchhaltungsprogramm erzeugt hat.

item.title: Banka odmietla súbor pain.001: päť najčastejších príčin chyby importu
item.description: Export hromadného príkazu vo formáte pain.001 z účtovného programu prebehol ako vždy, no banka pri importe súbor odmietla jedinou všeobecnou hláškou,

item.title: Classic novels as PDF for reMarkable and Kindle Scribe: Monte Cristo and Ben-Hur with a notes band on every page
item.description: The Count of Monte Cristo and Ben-Hur typeset for a 157 x 210 mm e-ink page, with a notes band on every page, a linked contents, the text unchanged from a public domain transcription, the measurements of the finished files, and what is not verified yet.

item.title: Dormice: a daily logic grid puzzle you solve from the clues alone
item.description: How a logic grid puzzle is read: ticks, crosses, the carry between tables, the auto cross switch and the week of levels in the daily Dormice puzzle.

item.title: Dormice: denná logická mriežka, ktorú vyriešite len z indícií
item.description: Ako sa číta logická mriežka: fajka, krížik, prenos medzi tabuľkami, prepínač Auto cross a týždenný plán úrovní v dennej hre Dormice.

item.title: Hybridná adresa v pain.001: najmenšia oprava, ktorú banka prijme
item.description: SEPA smeruje k štruktúrovanej adrese; koniec voľnej adresy, ktorý mal byť 15. 11. 2026, EPC 9. 9. 2026 odložila. Najmenšia oprava je hybridná adresa.

item.title: Hyperlinked puzzle PDFs for reMarkable and Kindle Scribe: what changes when the contents page is tappable
item.description: What a tappable contents page changes in a puzzle PDF for an e-ink tablet: a 157 x 210 mm page, 300 puzzles in three levels, Solution links both ways and three layouts of one puzzle set.

item.title: Kontrola SEPA súboru: EPC termín odložila, čo skutočne dostanete
item.description: European Payments Council 9. 9. 2026 odložila koniec neštruktúrovaných adries v SEPA platbách. Kontrola pain.001 aj tak ukáže štruktúrovanú adresu, pripravenosť na nový termín a menej odmietnutých platieb u bánk s prísnejšími pravidlami.

item.title: Kontrola SEPA súboru za 149 €: čo presne dostanete
item.description: Platená kontrola SEPA súboru pri ARLing stojí 149 € za jednu kontrolu jedného súboru, platí sa kartou cez Stripe a doklad vystavuje Stripe.
